description: React component for displaying and managing workflow webhooks, including webhook status summaries, webhook nodes listing, retry functionality, and navigation. It handles webhook node data display, user interactions for focusing and viewing webhooks, and provides UI elements for webhook statistics.

methods.name: EnhancedWorkflowWebhooks
methods.description: Main React component that displays a dashboard of webhook nodes, including summary cards, webhook details, and actions like retry and navigation.

methods.name: SummaryCard
methods.description: Helper component for rendering a summary statistic card with label, icon, value, and optional hint.
